term: Rational Numbers on the Number Line
termEs: Números racionales en la recta numérica
def: Each fraction or decimal has one exact spot on the line.
defEs: Cada fracción o decimal tiene un lugar exacto en la recta.
alt: Illustration of Rational Numbers on the Number Line: Each fraction or decimal has one exact spot on the line.

def: A number you can write as a fraction.
defEs: Un número que puedes escribir como fracción.
alt: Illustration of Rational number: A number you can write as a fraction.

def: A number that shows part of a whole.
defEs: Un número que muestra una parte de un todo.
alt: Illustration of Fraction: A number that shows part of a whole.

def: A number with a dot, like 0.5, that shows a part.
defEs: Un número con un punto, como 0.5, que muestra una parte.
alt: Illustration of Decimal: A number with a dot, like 0.5, that shows a part.

def: A line with numbers in order, left to right.
defEs: Una recta con los números en orden, de izquierda a derecha.
alt: Illustration of Number line: A line with numbers in order, left to right.

def: The same value shown in a new way.
defEs: El mismo valor escrito de otra manera.
alt: Illustration of Equivalent: The same value shown in a new way.

def: A whole number or its opposite, like 2 and −2.
defEs: Un número de contar, su opuesto o el cero, como 2, −2 y 0.
alt: Illustration of Integer: A whole number or its opposite, like 2 and −2.

def: A number the same distance from 0 on the other side.
defEs: Un número a la misma distancia del 0, del otro lado.
alt: Illustration of Opposite: A number the same distance from 0 on the other side.
